items.title: AbbVie’s (NYSE:ABBV) Q2 CY2026: Beats On Revenue
items.summary: Pharmaceutical company AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 10.2% year on year to $16.99 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.65 per share was 1.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: AbbVie Lowers Outlook to Account for Acquisition as Profit Jumps
items.summary: AbbVie lowered its full-year adjusted earnings outlook to account for its acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics, as the company logged higher profit and revenue in the recent quarter.

items.title: AbbVie Bought Apogee to Strengthen Its Portfolio. Now It’s Cutting Earnings Guidance.
items.summary: AbbVie  shares took a hit Friday after costs related to the drugmaker’s acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics forced a cut to its full-year profit outlook.  Second-quarter revenue jumped 10% to nearly $17 billion, beating the $16.8 billion consensus estimate among analysts polled by FactSet.  AbbVie  posted adjusted earnings of $3.65 a share, narrowly ahead of Wall Street’s call for $3.60.

items.title: AbbVie shares fall on earnings miss and weak guidance
items.summary: Investing.com -- AbbVie Inc. (NYSE: ABBV) reported second-quarter earnings before the open on Friday, missing profit expectations, although revenue beat the consensus estimate.
